## Problem

**S4 / `bioetl-provider-health-v2`:** Healthy Checks=0, Total=0, Failure Rate=0.00% green while Telemetry Freshness=UNKNOWN and provider selection empty. Zero-without-denominator must not look healthy; empty selection is N/A/applicability, not OK.

- [ ] Co-locate freshness chip with fleet severity
- [ ] Fleet-first remains default; selected-provider detail not first-screen owner when empty

- Loki/Tempo
